name: hertz-digital-rental-platform
description: Plateforme digitale de location de véhicules - Hertz Digital Rental Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:windows: concurrently "npm.cmd run dev --prefix backend" "npm.cmd run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ..
scripts.prisma:generate: cd backend && npx prisma generate --schema=src/prisma/schema.prisma && cd ..
scripts.prisma:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push --schema=src/prisma/schema.prisma --skip-generate && cd ..
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src=path.join('src','prisma','schema.prisma');const dest=path.join('dist','prisma');fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(src,path.join(dest,path.basename(src)));" && cd ..
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && node dist/prisma/seed.js || npx ts-node src/prisma/seed.ts || echo 'Seed ignore - OK' && cd ..
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:push && npm run build:backend && npm run db:seed
scripts.build:hostinger: npm run install:all && npm run build
scripts.build:windows: npm.cmd run build --prefix frontend && npm.cmd run build --prefix backend
scripts.db:setup:prod: cd backend && npx prisma generate --schema=src/prisma/schema.prisma && npx prisma db push --schema=src/prisma/schema.prisma
